B2 — corrected. Identity is (P13677 + section P958), not P13677 alone.

My earlier framing was wrong and this page replaces it. Emma: each Kokugakuin page id covers many entries, so items are unique by the combination of P13677 and its section qualifier P958 — except where the section is 0, where they need not be unique at all.

Checked against the live API, all 11 pairs the report called “same Kokugakuin id”: 7 have DIFFERENT sections (so they are not the same entry), 3 involve section 0 (uniqueness does not apply), and 1 shares (id, section) — where both sides are n/a.

So none of the 11 is an established duplicate. Note also that every register-entry twin carries section n/a — 12 of 12 — which looks systematic rather than incidental.

Nothing edited; Wikidata is locked to 2026-09-18.
